title: Award Seat Countdown
scenario: A text says premium award seats opened and will disappear unless you click within ten minutes.

answers.A: Click now and pay before the seats disappear.
answers.B: Search for the seats inside the airline or loyalty app.
answers.C: Forward the text to a travel companion for a second opinion.
answers.D: Open the airline site yourself and check the award inventory.

explanation: A countdown is designed to replace checking with reacting. Real award seats can be verified in the account or official search.
proTip: A real seat alert can wait while you open the official app.
